description: Reviews rls-saboteur runs. It reads the source database read-only, creates temporary labelled copies of it on the same server, breaks policies only in those copies, and drops them. Also reviews the flags that let it run against a non-local database, terminate other sessions on the source, or leave outbound HTTP on in the copies. Direct runs with --help, -h, --version, -v, --dry-run or --checks-only are not matched (launcher forms stay in review). Covers the rls-saboteur executable and npx, bunx, pnpx, pnpm, yarn, npm exec, npm x, bun x, pnpm dlx and yarn dlx launches, including versioned launches (rls-saboteur@tag).
name: rls-saboteur command protection
saferAlternatives: Point rls-saboteur at a local or disposable database, never production.
Run `rls-saboteur --dry-run` or `--checks-only` first; both read the catalogue and run no tests.
